sources.summary: British architecture studio RSHP has completed One Shanghai, an 186-metre mixed-use skyscraper in central Shanghai, China, informed by the city's historical laneway network. Located on Shimen First Road in Jing'an District, adjacent to the Zhang Garden retail quarter, the 38-storey skyscraper is comprised of three volumes that contain office, retail and public spaces. According to The post RSHP unveils tripartite Shanghai skyscraper informed by historical laneways appeared first on Dezeen .
